About Us
Bhushan Tubes Pvt.Ltd.
 an ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 accredited company is the leading Authorized distributor and stockiest of 
Jindal Pipes Ltd,Maharashtra Seamless Ltd, Surya Roshni Ltd, SAIL (Steel Authority of India Ltd) for MS ERW Pipes, Galvanized ERW Pipes, Seamless Pipes and Spiral Welded Pipes
 with enviable network of sales offices and warehouses at different locations within the country.
Our presence in this industry for more than 28 years has helped us to provide the expertise solutions to each requirement with the aim to give complete customer satisfaction. 
Our Annual Group Turnover for the year 2023-24 has been in excess of 950 Crores.
